thread:
marta: heads-up — onboarding hubert-7b hit a weird tokenization drift in our evals.

marta: local quick check shows the HF repo has both `tokenizer.json` and `tokenizer_config.json`, but the fast loader picks up `tokenizer.json` that lacks `special_tokens_map` entries we normally expect. slow tokenizer (python) reads `tokenizer_config.json` and gets the specials. results differ.

omar: ah classic fast vs slow. do you have an example input where outputs diverge?

marta: short repro: input = "Hello </s> world". fast -> token ids map to different end-of-sentence token; generation truncates in our beam evals. slow -> behaves as expected.

sasha: any missing files reported? HF usually ships `special_tokens_map.json` or inline config.

marta: repo only had `tokenizer.json` + `config.json`. no `special_tokens_map.json`. `tokenizer_config.json` exists but is minimal — only `unk_token`. seems like some conversion step dropped the chat-template specials.

liam: could be the conversion script we run for HF->redwood expects `tokenizer_config.json` to override? we do prefer the fast file if present.

omar: workaround: recreate `special_tokens_map.json` from slow tokenizer and add it next to `tokenizer.json`. fast loader will pick it up. I did that locally and evals matched.

marta: confirmed — adding `special_tokens_map.json` fixed the e2e rouge/bleu drop on hubert-7b.

sasha: we should also add a startup warning in the model import pipeline when `tokenizer.json` present but `special_tokens_map.json` is missing or `tokenizer_config.json` has entries not present in `tokenizer.json`.

liam: +1. small patch idea: importer merges `tokenizer_config.json` -> `tokenizer.json`'s `added_tokens` and `special_tokens_map` before serializing fast tokenizer. fallback if keys absent.

eval-bot: [automated] REGRESSION ALERT: hubert-7b quantized fp16 -> int8 eval bump: ROUGE-L -3.1% (investigate tokenizer mismatch) :warning: 

marta: tagging for triage — @omar can you add the importer guard? @sasha can you add a regen test to the model-onboard CI that loads both fast and slow tokenizers and asserts identical tokenization for canonical prompts?

omar: on it. will push a small validation step and a unit that synthesizes `special_tokens_map.json` from slow loader if missing.

sasha: will add the CI test and a short doc note in onboarding checklist about verifying `special_tokens_map.json` and chat-template placeholders.

marta: thanks. leaving the repro in /tmp/hubert-token-debug.tar.gz (I dropped it in the model-onboard s3 bucket, link in #eng-infra).

liam: follow-up: also watch quantization evals — sometimes token id shifts look fine at decode but change logits ordering after quantization. need to verify token id parity before running expensive quant experiments.

marta: agreed. we'll gate int8 runs until importer + CI landed.

omar: PR incoming in ~2h with importer guard + small CLI to dump merged tokenizer files.

marta: awesome, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
